general.message: I’m not aware of an official “immigration index” for France in 2025. The OECD typically publishes **Immigration Flows (per 1,000 population)**, and the last available French data (2023) was about **27 persons per 1,000**. Any 2025 figure would be a projection and varies by source. If you need a specific model or agency estimate, let me know and I can look up the latest forecasts.
